compared.difference: That item counts the encode-decode computation of the fundamental group of the circle, pi_1(S^1) = Z, from section 6.2 of the same chapter. The present item is the earlier Lemma 6.2.9, the universal property (S^1 -> A) ~ Sigma x:A, x = x, which the encode-decode section cites as background; it contains no successor covering, no code family and no winding number.

The recursion principle (Lemma 6.2.5) is a different labelled statement from the universal property (Lemma 6.2.9): the recursion principle produces a map S^1 -> A from a point and a loop, while the universal property identifies the whole function type S^1 -> A with the sigma type of based loops. The recursion principle is used as a prerequisite here, not counted again.
